title: DOW-UAP-D091, Range Fouler Debrief, Atlantic Ocean, 2020
doc_notes: This is a military range fouler debrief form containing a firsthand account of a close-approach encounter.

encounters.summary: Aircrew observed a dark, maroon-colored object approximately 12-15 feet in height that appeared as a deformed balloon while operating in restricted airspace.
encounters.entity_appearance: dark, maroonish color, somewhat deformed balloon
encounters.quote: The object itself was a darker, maroonish color, approximately 12-15ft in height.
